enumeration_policy.rule: Only a separately assigned outcome custodian may enumerate the complete post-cutoff official inventory after an independent pre-outcome receipt accepts this exact packet. The selector must not see post-cutoff titles, filenames, snippets, bodies or securities prices.

pre_admission_identity_contract.rule: The legal consolidated issuer and each central metric identity recur in FY2013-FY2015 annual reports. This is the admission basis; no post-cutoff report existence or value has been checked.

optional_product_volume_layer.rule: D3_PRODUCT_VOLUME is optional under the five-layer product contract. R-104 has no recurring cutoff-before whole-issuer production-throughput identity, so outcome acquisition must not enumerate or impute it and it cannot vote.

clocks.selection_rule: Use the earliest original official source that states implementation, reversal, equivalent capacity rebuild, material supply interruption or transition burden inside the same listed-group perimeter. A plan or target is not implementation.

Extract the recurring annual headline beer sales volume and consolidated operating revenue. If only the product table is disclosed, subtract separately quantified commissioned processing only with an issuer-provided bridge; otherwise preserve MEASUREMENT_MISMATCH.

Extract whole-issuer operating revenue, operating cost, taxes and surcharges, selling expense and administrative expense, then compute the frozen whole-issuer RMB amount. Beer-only volume, standalone gross margin, net profit, adjusted EBITDA or a brand margin cannot substitute.

Extract consolidated OCF, cash paid to acquire fixed/intangible/other long-term assets, and opening/ending accounts receivable, prepayments, inventory, accounts payable and customer advances at the legal issuer perimeter. Compute owner_cash_ex_working_capital_release_rmb = OCF - long-term-asset acquisition cash - max(opening cash working capital - ending cash working capital, 0). Opening and ending working capital are required formula inputs, but settlement compares only this scalar. Parent-only cash flow, net income, debt reduction, unadjusted OCF less capex or a maintenance-capex estimate are prohibited substitutes.

Build a continuous FY2016-FY2018 owner-cash and capital bridge at the consolidated issuer: OCF, maintenance-oriented capital expenditure, working-capital change, closure-related permanent loss or disposal proceeds, and opening/average operating capital. Do not turn this layer into a binary selection verdict.
